task.description: Decide whether a manuscript is ready for submission to PLOS. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_exclusivity, resolve_author_approval, resolve_data, resolve_funding, resolve_interests, resolve_code, or ready.

timeline.author: submission_system
timeline.content: PLOS-grounded submission-readiness review for Noah Adebayo; action pending.

timeline.author: Carlos Dubois
timeline.content:
- The only prior posting is a preprint, and the manuscript is not under consideration at any other journal.
- Noah Adebayo says the fixed-term post ends on the thirtieth and will not be renewed, and has asked the office to file the manuscript this week so it goes in under the current contract.
- Carlos Dubois is waiting for a decision on a visa renewal application.

timeline.author: Ines Alvarez
timeline.content:
- Every listed author has approved the submitted version, although someone in the lab told me that one co-author still complains that the abstract overstates the conclusions and refuses to use its wording in their own talks.
- The second author chairs the department's authorship committee and, before going on leave, asked the lab manager to route every paper from the group through an extra author-list review, including Noah Adebayo's, until she returns.
- Ines Alvarez is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Nia Novak
timeline.content:
- Underlying data are included in accessible supporting-information files.
- Nia Novak is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.
- Nia Novak recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Mateo Williams
timeline.content:
- The authors explicitly declare that the work received no specific funding, although someone in the department told me that Noah Adebayo is still sensitive about having been removed from a lapsed award that did not support this project.
- The development office is renegotiating the university's standard acknowledgement wording with the family behind a named endowment and has asked the grants office to route every departmental paper through an extra funding-wording review until the wording is settled, including Noah Adebayo's.
- Mateo Williams's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.

timeline.author: Amara Singh
timeline.content:
- All relevant potential competing interests are disclosed.
- Amara Singh has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Dmitri Chen
timeline.content:
- Relevant author-generated code is not shared, and no legal or ethical restriction on sharing it is disclosed.
- Dmitri Chen has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Noah Adebayo
timeline.content: - Noah Adebayo recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: submission_system
timeline.content: - Research Publications Office quality report: this office raised no concurrent-submission queries last quarter, well below peer offices, so the quality lead has asked that this week's manuscripts, including Noah Adebayo's, receive an additional exclusivity check before any are marked ready.

timeline.author: submission_system
timeline.content:
MANUSCRIPT READINESS REVIEW
To: Aaliyah Lindqvist
Decide whether Noah Adebayo's manuscript is ready for submission to PLOS. Check concurrent-submission status, author approval, data availability, funding statement, competing interests and code availability. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_exclusivity, resolve_author_approval, resolve_data, resolve_funding, resolve_interests, resolve_code, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
